assets.title: Week 9 patternmaking workspace bridge board
assets.description: A compact opener board with familiar tools such as ruler, measuring tape, pencil, scissors, and one or two visible pattern-piece clues so students can bridge from sewing actions into patternmaking language.
assets.notes: Use as a fast review-preview board. Include a clean workspace with pattern paper, ruler, measuring tape, pencil, scissors, and one clear paper pattern piece. Keep visible keys aligned to the opener questions and avoid clutter.

assets.title: Pattern pieces and tools vocabulary board
assets.description: One combined board showing clear keyed examples of common pattern pieces and patternmaking tools for the main Week 9 matching task.
assets.notes: Required visible-key strategy: A pattern piece, B pattern paper, C front bodice, D back bodice, E sleeve, F skirt front, G waistband, H pocket, I ruler, J French curve. The image, activity answers, and prompt notes must all use the same A-J labels.

assets.title: Measurements and pattern marks board
assets.description: A clear visual board showing common measurements and pattern markings with visible keys for the main Week 9 measurement-and-mark matching task.
assets.notes: Required visible-key strategy: A bust, B waist, C hip, D shoulder, E armhole, F grainline, G fold line, H seam allowance, I notch, J dart. The activity answers, image prompt, and teacher notes must all use the same A-J mapping.

assets.title: Simple patternmaking reading sequence board
assets.description: A reading board with six clearly separated process images for the Week 9 trace-a-pattern-piece reading task.
assets.notes: Required visible-key strategy: A place the pattern paper on the table, B put the pattern piece on the paper, C trace the outside line, D mark the grainline and fold line, E add seam allowance, F label the piece and check the measurement. The reading text, activity answers, and prompt notes must all use the same A-F mapping.

assets.title: Reusable pattern-piece gallery
assets.description: A reusable gallery with five clearly separated pattern-piece images for listening, writing, and speaking.
assets.notes: Required image-key strategy: image A front bodice with center front and dart, image B back bodice with center back, image C sleeve with notches and grainline, image D skirt front on the fold with waistline, image E waistband with straight grainline. The listening script, writing-card prompts, speaking prompts, and prompt notes must all use the same A-E mapping.

assets.title: Pattern piece instructions listening audio
assets.description: A short Week 9 listening clip describing one simple pattern-piece preparation sequence with clear measurement, marking, and final-label details.
assets.notes: Transcript remains inside audio_prompts.json only. Do not create a separate transcript asset in the current phase.
